title: Kinetics of DNA-Mediated Liposome Fusion with Different Binding Modes.
authors: Tang, Hao; Qiu, Xiandeng; Wang, Rong
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化分子动力学模拟研究DNA介导脂质体融合的动力学与自由能垒，虽涉及DNA-膜互作而非蛋白质-DNA结合，且方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，但对象偏离核心体系，故评分较低。
abstract: DNA-mediated membrane fusion has great prospects in spatiotemporal control over fusion events, attributed to DNA's inherent programmability and addressability. However, the kinetics remain largely unknown, and whether zipper-like hybridization orientation is a prerequisite remains an open question. Herein, we employed a coarse-grained molecular dynamics method to systematically investigate the mechanism and kinetics of DNA-mediated liposome fusion under two distinct DNA binding modes: zipper and bridge. The results indicated that zipper mode is more favorable for fusion, while bridge mode exhibits a strong dependence on DNA linker length. The free energy barriers of liposome fusion were determined to be 10.17 k(B)T for zipper mode and 12.21 k(B)T for bridge mode, respectively. Furthermore, the membrane curvature and surface DNA density were identified as the main factors affecting fusion kinetics, and the optimal parameter ranges for promoting liposome fusion were also determined. These findings provide valuable insights for the rational design and optimization of DNA-mediated liposome fusion systems.
abstract_zh: DNA介导的膜融合在融合事件的时空控制方面具有巨大前景，这归因于DNA固有的可编程性和可寻址性。然而，其动力学仍 largely 未知，且拉链式杂交取向是否为先决条件仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在此，我们采用粗粒化分子动力学方法，系统研究了两种不同DNA结合模式——拉链（zipper）和桥接（bridge）——下DNA介导的脂质体融合的机制与动力学。结果表明，拉链模式更有利于融合，而桥接模式则对DNA连接子长度表现出强烈依赖性。脂质体融合的自由能垒分别确定为拉链模式的10.17 k(B)T和桥接模式的12.21 k(B)T。此外，膜曲率和表面DNA密度被识别为影响融合动力学的主要因素，并确定了促进脂质体融合的最佳参数范围。这些发现为DNA介导的脂质体融合系统的合理设计与优化提供了宝贵见解。
